label: Regular
description: The standard waistcoat hem featuring two pointed tabs (a 'W' shape), one beneath each front, which is the most common daywear bottom. The points sit just below the waistband to ensure no shirt shows beneath the vest. This shape elongates the torso and reads as the default classic finish.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
